posts.text:
🐣 Calling All Kingdom Experts! Feed Eggy Some
New Knowledge!

The Kingdom is full of exciting ways to play: Hero
development, team building, seasonal gameplay,
event strategies... Along the way, every Lord picks up
useful tips and tricks of their own.

Now, our smart little assistant, Eggy, wants to learn
from the best!
Whether it's practical tips, gameplay insights, or
those "I wish I'd known this sooner!" tricks that help
you avoid common mistakes, we'd love for you to
teach Eggy a thing or two!~

Feed your knowledge to Eggy and help it pick up
more useful tricks!

🎁Submission Period: September 18 – October 7
🎁Review Period: October 8 – October 25
🎁Rewards Distributed: October 26

🎁 Event Rewards

Submit a valid entry that meets the event
requirements to receive a Participation Reward! If
your guide is selected by our team, you'll also receive
an additional Excellence Reward. And yes, rewards
can be stacked!

🏆 Excellence Reward: USD 4.99 or USD 19.99
The more detailed and helpful your guide is, the
better your chances of reaching the higher reward
tier!

🎉 Participation Reward (once per person):
200 Diamonds + 1 Silver Chest + 1 Recruitment Order

📖 What Kind of Guides Can You Share?

Any game guide that can help other Lords is
welcome!

Here are some areas you can choose from:

🐣 Beginner Guides: What are the must-know tips for
new players?
📊 Stats & Resources: How can you plan your
resources and progression efficiently?
⚔️ Hero Development: How should you develop your
Heroes? Which skills should you prioritize?
🧩 Team Building: How should you build your teams
for different situations?
🌎 Seasonal Gameplay: What are the new mechanics
in the latest season? How can you make the most of
them?
🔥 Limited-Time Events: How should you plan your
participation? How can you maximize your rewards?

As long as you think your tips can help other Lords,
don't be shy. Share your best tricks with everyone!

✍️ How to Participate

① Create Your Guide

You can submit either a text guide or an image guide.

For text guides, we recommend at least 200 words
and encourage you to clearly explain your strategy,
methods, and key data.

For image guides, we recommend using real in-game
screenshots with arrows, circles, text annotations, and
other visual aids to make everything easy to
understand at a glance!

Make your guide truly useful, easy to understand, and
easy for Eggy to learn from!

② Don't Forget Your UID

Please include your UID in every guide. Your UID
should also be included in the file name of your
submission so we can organize and verify entries
more easily and make sure your work doesn't get lost
along the way! 🐥

③ Submit Your Guide

Once your guide is ready, click the link below to fill
out the form and upload your submission:

👉 

④ Submit More, Win More!

You can submit guides on different topics separately,
and each guide has a chance to win an Excellence
Reward!

Rewards can be stacked, so don't keep your secret
tricks to yourself! 👀

📌 Event Rules

1. Only guides submitted during the event period will
be considered for this event.

2. Please do not submit content unrelated to the
event, such as advertisements or unrelated
promotions.

3. Please protect your privacy and the privacy of
other players. Do not include real names, addresses,
phone numbers, email addresses, or other personal
information in your guide.

4. Please submit your own original content. Do not
plagiarize or copy other people's work. If you quote
or use someone else's content, please obtain
permission and clearly credit the original source.

5. Do not share unreleased game content or obtain
unreleased information through data mining or other
means.

6. Please do not post illegal, inappropriate, or harmful
content, including but not limited to politically
sensitive content, pornography, violence, defamation,
cheats, or other prohibited content.

7. This event will be held simultaneously across
multiple platforms. All submissions from all platforms
will be collected and reviewed together. There will be
no separate judging or awards for individual
platforms.

8. By participating in this event, you agree that we
may use your submitted work in Top Heroes-related
public promotions, community activities, and content
related to the Eggy Q&A Assistant.

9. The official Top Heroes team reserves the right of
final interpretation of this event and its results.

🐥 Eggy has its little notebook ready!
Now it's just waiting for everyone to come and teach
it! Don't keep your secrets to yourself. Come share
your knowledge with Eggy!
